name: Reverse Box Turn (forward half)
notes: Owner's description (2026-11-16): the Box Turn with everything reversed. The turn is to the left; the lead starts forward on the left foot, side on the right, close the left. The mirror image of Box Turn (forward half), with the same sizes (0.5 forward, then the right foot lands 0.4 beyond the left in the turned frame, measured from the facing before the turn as 0.9 forward and 0.2 left), the whole quarter turn on count 2, the feet closing on 3 and no rise. Usually followed by Reverse Box Turn (backward half). Called the Left Box Turn in the American syllabus; the International Reverse Turn is a different, progressive figure. Like Box Turn (forward half), the lead goes forward on count 2, so the couple turns round the follow (the default turning centre, 2026-11-17) and step 2 is written as her step: 0.6 forward and 0.7 left as he'd say it (0.6 back and 0.7 to her right for her), chosen so that he lands where he did before. With her offset to his right, a left turn round her moves him as far as her (0.92 each). Exempt from the "partner spacing" and "crossed feet" checks: the feet still pass too close on counts 2 and 3 and her feet cross briefly, as in the Box Turn's forward half. Remove skipChecks with the Box Turn's in the figure clean-up.
